subject: A2A diagnostic: isolate Storybook runtime failure with existing tools
body: This is a minimal isolated diagnostic, not another blind bootstrap retry. Use only commands already supported by the current worker. The purpose is to force command-level evidence into the existing local_exec result: Node/npm versions, actual Storybook directory/package state, and the real build stdout/stderr/returncode. Do not modify homepage, Journal, Storybook source, or install dependencies in this task. If the build fails, the canonical receipt must preserve the local_exec result evidence rather than collapsing the useful result into generic task_failed. This task is simultaneously Storybook hardening evidence and Doré↔ChatGPT A2A project #272 evidence: silence/failure is a signal and each attempt must increase information.
